occupation_index_interpretation: two chosen wavefunctions with occupations 0 and 1 in one selected excitation direction per boundary sector; not two mode profiles

parity_selection_rule.assumptions: joint action, measure, regulator and domain invariant under simultaneous real-field sign reversal; packets have parity (-1)^n
parity_selection_rule.forbidden_if_assumptions_hold: different incoming and outgoing occupation parity
parity_selection_rule.does_not_forbid: stratum mixing or transitions from occupation 0 to excluded occupation 2
